entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Mukasa Zuza was a Roman Catholic bishop. Born in Malembo, Angola, Zuza was ordained in 1982 to serve in the Diocese of Mzuzu, Malawi. He was appointed Bishop of the Mzuzu Diocese in 1995. He died at age 59 in a road accident while still in office.
